mapper.select: SELECT RULEID ,RULE_NM ,RULEALIAS_NM ,RULE_DESC ,RULERETURN_TYPE ,RULESORT_CD ,RULEUSAGE_CD ,ALLRETURN_YN ,USE_YN ,RULE_VERNO ,ACTIVATE_YN ,ACTIVATE_DATETIME ,RULE_STATE ,DEPLOY_DATETIME ,DEPLOY_USERID ,IFID ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME FROM RULE_HIST WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid} and RULE_VERNO = #{currentRuleVer}
SELECT RULEID ,RETURN_ITEMID ,RULE_VERNO ,RETURNITEM_NO ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME FROM RULERETURNITEM_HIST WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid} and RULE_VERNO = #{currentRuleVer}

SELECT RULEID ,RULECONDITIONNO ,RULE_VERNO ,CONDITION_INFIX_DESC ,CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC ,CONDITION_DESC ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME FROM RULECONDITION_HIST WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid} and RULE_VERNO = #{currentRuleVer}

SELECT RULEID ,RULE_NM ,RULEALIAS_NM ,RULE_DESC ,RULERETURN_TYPE ,RULESORT_CD ,RULEUSAGE_CD ,ALLRETURN_YN ,USE_YN ,RULE_VERNO ,ACTIVATE_YN ,ACTIVATE_DATETIME ,RULE_STATE ,DEPLOY_DATETIME ,DEPLOY_USERID ,IFID ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME FROM RULE WHERE RULEID = #{value}
SELECT RULEID ,RETURN_ITEMID ,RETURNITEM_NO ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME FROM RULERETURNITEM WHERE RULEID = #{value}

SELECT RULEID ,RULECONDITIONNO ,CONDITION_INFIX_DESC ,CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC ,CONDITION_DESC ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME FROM RULECONDITION WHERE RULEID = #{value}
mapper.insert: insert into RULE_HIST ( RULEID ,RULE_VERNO ,RULE_NM ,RULEALIAS_NM ,RULE_DESC ,RULERETURN_TYPE ,RULESORT_CD ,RULEUSAGE_CD ,ALLRETURN_YN ,USE_YN ,ACTIVATE_YN ,ACTIVATE_DATETIME ,RULE_STATE ,DEPLOY_DATETIME ,DEPLOY_USERID ,IFID ,RULEVERSIONCHANGECODE ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME )select RULEID ,RULE_VERNO ,RULE_NM ,RULEALIAS_NM ,RULE_DESC ,RULERETURN_TYPE ,RULESORT_CD ,RULEUSAGE_CD ,ALLRETURN_YN ,USE_YN ,ACTIVATE_YN ,ACTIVATE_DATETIME ,RULE_STATE ,DEPLOY_DATETIME ,DEPLOY_USERID ,IFID ,#{ruleversionchangecode} ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME from RULE where ruleid = #{ruleid}

insert into RULERETURNITEM_HIST ( RULEID ,RETURN_ITEMID ,RULE_VERNO ,RETURNITEM_NO ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME )select RULEID ,RETURN_ITEMID ,#{ruleVerno} ,RETURNITEM_NO ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME from RULERETURNITEM where ruleid = #{ruleid}

insert into RULECONDITION_HIST ( RULEID ,RULECONDITIONNO ,RULE_VERNO ,CONDITION_INFIX_DESC ,CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC ,CONDITION_DESC ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME )select RULEID ,RULECONDITIONNO ,#{ruleVerno} ,CONDITION_INFIX_DESC ,CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC ,CONDITION_DESC ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME from RULECONDITION where ruleid = #{ruleid}

insert into RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT_HI ( RULEID ,POSTFIXOBJECTNO ,RULECONDITIONNO ,RULE_VERNO ,DATATYPE_CD ,OPERATOR_YN ,OBJECT_DATA )select RULEID ,POSTFIXOBJECTNO ,RULECONDITIONNO ,#{ruleVerno} ,DATATYPE_CD ,OPERATOR_YN ,OBJECT_DATA from RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT where ruleid = #{ruleid}

insert into RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM_HIST ( RETURN_ITEMID ,RULEID ,RULECONDITIONNO ,RULE_VERNO ,RETURNITEM_EXPR_DESC ,RETURNITEM_POSTFIX_DESC ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME )select RETURN_ITEMID ,RULEID ,RULECONDITIONNO ,#{ruleVerno} ,RETURNITEM_EXPR_DESC ,RETURNITEM_POSTFIX_DESC ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME from RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM where ruleid = #{ruleid}
mapper.select: SELECT RULEID ,RULE_NM ,RULEALIAS_NM ,RULE_DESC ,RULERETURN_TYPE ,RULESORT_CD ,RULEUSAGE_CD ,ALLRETURN_YN ,USE_YN ,RULE_VERNO ,ACTIVATE_YN ,(TO_CHAR(ACTIVATE_DATETIME,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS')) as ACTIVATE_DATETIME ,(select code_nm from clover_code where code_type='604' and code = SUBSTR(RULE_STATE,0,1)) as RULE_STATE ,(TO_CHAR(DEPLOY_DATETIME,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS')) as DEPLOY_DATETIME ,(select user_nm from clover_user where user_id = DEPLOY_USERID) as DEPLOY_USERID ,IFID ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,(select user_nm from clover_user where user_id = UPDATE_USERID) as UPDATE_USERID ,(SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,7,2)||' '||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,9,2)||':'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,11,2)||':'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,13,2) )as UPDATE_DATETIME ,RULEVERSIONCHANGECODE FROM RULE_HIST WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid} order by RULE_VERNO desc

SELECT a.RULEID ,A.RETURN_ITEMID ,A.RULE_VERNO ,A.RETURNITEM_NO ,A.UPDATE_USERID ,A.UPDATE_DATETIME ,b.ITEM_NM ,b.ITEMALIAS_NM ,(SELECT CODE_NM FROM CLOVER_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = '102' AND CODE = b.DATATYPE_CD) AS DATATYPE_NM FROM RULERETURNITEM_HIST A ,ruleitem b WHERE A.RETURN_ITEMID = b.ITEMID and RULEID = #{ruleid}

SELECT RULEID ,RULECONDITIONNO ,RULE_VERNO ,CONDITION_INFIX_DESC ,CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC ,CONDITION_DESC ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME ,( SELECT LISTAGG(RETURNITEM_EXPR_DESC, ':__:') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY RULECONDITIONNO) AS concatenated_values FROM RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM_HIST GROUP BY RULEID, RULE_VERNO,RULECONDITIONNO having RULEID = a.RULEID and RULE_VERNO = a.RULE_VERNO and RULECONDITIONNO = a.RULECONDITIONNO ) as RESULT_VALUE FROM RULECONDITION_HIST a WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid}

SELECT RULEID ,RULECONDITIONNO ,RULE_VERNO ,CONDITION_INFIX_DESC ,CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC ,CONDITION_DESC ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME ,( SELECT LISTAGG(RETURNITEM_EXPR_DESC, ':__:') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY RULECONDITIONNO) AS concatenated_values FROM RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM_HIST GROUP BY RULEID, RULE_VERNO,RULECONDITIONNO having RULEID = a.RULEID and RULE_VERNO = a.RULE_VERNO and RULECONDITIONNO = a.RULECONDITIONNO ) as RESULT_VALUE FROM RULECONDITION_HIST a WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid}
